<meta>.purpose: Reverts that are intended. A changed file whose content is byte-identical to an earlier revision of itself is reported by `check` as a stale side; an entry here explains one instead.
<meta>.required: Every entry needs `path` (repository-relative) and `reason`. Put a board item id in the reason, so the decision can be reviewed.
<meta>.optional: `blob` pins the entry to the content it was written for. Without it the entry covers any stale content that file ever reaches; with it the entry stops explaining when the file reaches a different revision, and the guard reports the new one.

example.reason: ATLAS-EXAMPLE-2026-09-17: the older revision is the intended state
